subject: Request: one-time commercial exemption for Medimaps RFP
messages:
From: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@medimaps.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Medimaps RFP: commercial ask and timeline

Vivek —

Thanks again for the time today. We really like Redwood's latency/cost story; the technical fit is strong. Procurement pushed me to get a written commercial proposal for our upcoming RFP run. Key asks from Medimaps: 40% list discount on the hosted inference line, and inclusion of a dedicated VPC environment (no charge) for the first 12 months.

Timeline is tight: final vendor selection by 2026-12-20, pilot start hoped for early Jan. If you can send a commercial position today or early tomorrow, I can escalate on our end.

I've attached the RFP summary and a short list of competitors' offers (they've put in aggressive bundled credits + lower list rate).

—Alex
Alex Garcia
Head of Cloud Procurement, Medimaps
alex.garcia@medimaps.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Medimaps RFP: commercial ask and timeline

Alex —

Appreciate the clarity and the deadline. I'm looping in Marissa and Karthik (commercial) to surface this as a one-off request for VP/CFO approval — the ask (40% + free VPC) is outside our standard guardrails.

Preliminary position from our side: we can consider a blended concession that preserves unit economics and reduces risk for Redwood. Options we discussed internally this morning:
- Pilot concession: 30% list discount for first 6 months + a dedicated VPC (no infra fee) with a 6-month usage floor (to preserve minimum revenue).
- Marketing/case study credit: add an additional 5% marketing credit contingent on Medimaps agreeing to a public case study and 6-month reference commitment.
- Gradual step-down: discount reverts to standard tiers after month 6 unless usage targets are met.

If you can share the competitor pricing line items (credits vs. recurring rate) we can be more specific. I'm attaching a proposed_pricing_table.xlsx with a conservative structure to discuss internally.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: Medimaps commercial exemption recommendation (for VP/CFO signoff)

Team —

Summary: Medimaps (prospect, enterprise healthcare) is asking for 40% off list + free dedicated VPC for 12 months. Competitive pressure is real; two competitors are offering ~35–40% blended with upfront infrastructure credits. They will select by 12/20.

Proposal (recommended):
1) Offer a one-time commercial exemption limited to this deal: 30% list discount for months 0–6 + free dedicated VPC for months 0–6.
2) Add a 5% marketing/case-study credit (applied as a monthly credit over months 1–6) contingent on a public case study and 6-month reference window.
3) Impose a minimum committed usage floor for month 1–6 equal to 60% of our conservative forecast (documented in attached pricing spreadsheet). If floor not met, credit clawback applies.
4) Spread recognition impact: treat the marketing credit as a contra-revenue spread over 12 months (finance to advise exact accounting).

Rationale: preserves gross margin vs. an unconditional 40% cut, keeps pilot low-friction for Medimaps, and creates marketing upside. The structure is reversible after 6 months and includes a clawback to mitigate churn risk.

Financial ask for approval: exception to discount cap (normally 25%) and approval to include a 6-month free VPC. Estimated incremental ARR trade-off vs. competitor loss: ~$260k NPV over 12 months if they sign. See attached proposed_pricing_table.xlsx for numbers.

Request: VP/CFO signoff required to proceed with a redlineable commercial offer. Karthik — please advise if you'd like the finance wording changed; Lauren, please confirm accounting treatment for the marketing credit (spread vs. lump). Jonas, flag any legal or SOC2 gating for the free VPC.

Attachment: proposed_pricing_table.xlsx

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Medimaps commercial exemption recommendation (for VP/CFO signoff)

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the crisp memo. I reviewed the numbers in the pricing sheet. I approve the commercial exemption on the conditions below:

Conditions of approval (Karthik Iyer, VP Sales):
- Approve 30% list discount (months 0–6) + free dedicated VPC (months 0–6) + 5% marketing credit contingent on case study.
- Marketing credit must be documented and applied as a monthly credit that finance agrees to spread over 12 months (Lauren, please confirm the recommended accounting treatment).
- Usage floor of 60% must be contractually enforced with a clawback clause for credits if floor not met in months 1–6. Legal to prepare language (Jonas).
- Commercial offer expires if not executed by 2026-12-20.

Next steps: Vivek, please send the redlineable term sheet to Alex with the conditions above and copy Marissa & Legal. Lauren, please confirm accounting and whether Treasury needs visibility for any credit letters. If Lauren gives finance sign-off, this can be considered VP + CFO level approval and we can proceed to finalize.

Approved (provisionally) — Karthik Iyer
Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
